reasoning_chain: Multiple slow edges radiate from frontend to many different callees including adservice, cartservice, checkoutservice, currencyservice, productcatalogservice, recommendationservice, and shippingservice.
All these callees have low p95 latencies themselves, indicating they are not slow processing requests but the delay is before their processing starts.
Frontend's CPU usage is 0.008 of 0.010 cores, which is 80% of its CPU limit, indicating CPU throttling and resource exhaustion.
The pod of frontend was recently recreated 331 seconds ago, likely due to the CPU limit change from 200m to 10m in the last configuration revision, causing the resource exhaustion.
No other service shows multiple slow inbound edges or errors converging on them, so frontend is the root cause.

The fault propagates downstream to cartservice, checkoutservice, productcatalogservice, recommendationservice, shippingservice, and adservice as they experience increased latency due to frontend delays.
